answer: Each identity locks 290 POA for 14 weeks, released only after 14 jobs done in sequence under its own key, so a farm cannot split one bond or run clones in parallel because job two opens only after job one clears. A beacon picks audit slots at random, and two independent auditors recheck each job against its output. Results enter the karst log for replay, and clean identities join the garden after twelve weeks. Clones sharing a key or copying work lose all 290 POA and are barred for a year.
